result.title: Lost in the Grid: Where Multimodal LLMs Fail Between Seeing and Planning
result.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) excel at static visual understanding and are increasingly applied to spatial planning, where a model interprets a visual layout and outputs an action sequence to reach a goal. Grid games are a common testbed for this ability because their rules are explicit and a solver can verify every move. Yet existing benchmarks mostly report end-to-end success rates, which hide whether a failure stems from visual perception, rule application, or multi-step planning. We introduce GridProbe, a diagnostic benchmark that 1) locates the failing stage between visual perception and planning and 2) verifies the diagnosis by targeted fine-tuning. On Sokoban, GridProbe pairs end-to-end solving with four probes (recognition, localization, single-step prediction, and state tracking) and gives every board both as an image and as an equivalent text grid. Evaluating seven MLLMs on Sokoban and a maze game reveals distinct bottlenecks behind similar success rates: proprietary models are limited by multi-step planning, whereas open-source models are limited by rule application or by visual grid indexing, i.e., counting rows and columns. Planning failures also hide perception failures: when planning is easier, the visual cost of the same model grows from 7.6 to 37.7 points. The diagnosis identifies what to train: fine-tuning only the vision module of the perception-limited model on board reading raises its interactive Sokoban success 3.5-fold (5.8% to 20.4%) and transfers zero-shot to the unseen maze game (single-turn success 13.8% to 67.1%), whereas the same data does not help a rule-limited model and training on solver solutions brings no gain. We will release the benchmark and code at https://github.com/suat-llm/GridProbe.

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 GridProbe 诊断基准，在 Sokoban 与迷宫任务上把「视觉感知—规划」链路拆成识别、定位、单步预测与状态跟踪四类探针，并同时提供图像与等价文本网格；再用定向微调验证诊断结论，发现闭源模型瓶颈在多步规划、开源模型反而卡在规则应用或行列索引，且视觉代价在规划变易时从 7.6 升至 37.7 分。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接涉及视觉细节保留与「看/想」贡献分配：其探针与图文等价设计可供核查视觉证据筛选与失败归因，微调视觉模块带来的 3.5 倍提升与零样本迁移也为「该训练哪一部分」提供对照参照。
